text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board (Board) with the following: 1. The Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund performance for the first quarter of 2025. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance check for the first quarter of 2025.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Received this report for information. 2. Requested the Director, Capital Markets along with the investment consultant (Aon), to complete an Asset Mix Review that will include long-term, five and ten year economic investment scenarios and their implications for the Toronto Investment Board's long-term investment strategy, and report back to the December 12, 2025 meeting.
